findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers to the client immediately upon creation and as a work made for hire, prior to full payment, exposing you to financial risk if payment is delayed.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Incorporated Technology Works shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a good day. Before I sign the agreement, I would like to suggest a modification to the relevant clause. - Regarding the clause where ownership transfers immediately upon creation before full payment, this poses financial risks. I propose that ownership of the Incorporated Technology Works shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverables. Thank you for your flexibility. Best regards,
